ADR-007 is accepted: the Validation meta-schema activates directly, while JSONSchemaValidation in $uses activates only under the Extended meta-schema. Broader companion capability coverage remains partial.
ADR-014 remains pending because the Validation draft requires an object-typed schema but gives a string-typed example.

Conditional Composition authoring, inspection, recursive capability-aware validation, and reference traversal are implemented. Runtime instance evaluation, global unsatisfiable-composition analysis, and executable depth budgets remain pending under ADR-019.
The bounded milestone validates common RFC 5646 language-tag structure but does not ship the complete registry-aware RFC 5646 grammar.
The bounded milestone validates common case-sensitive UCUM expressions and substantial advisory seeds; full UCUM grammar and dimensional equivalence require a dedicated UCUM engine.
Known unit/UCUM pairs produce non-destructive compatibility warnings; arbitrary dimensional equivalence remains indeterminate without a UCUM engine.

The bounded milestone validates RFC 5646 language-tag structure, including grandfathered and private-use forms, case-insensitive variant uniqueness, and extension-singleton uniqueness, but does not ship complete registry-aware validation.

The Extended meta-schema offers altnames and altsymbols while the companion draft specifies altnames, altenums, and descriptions; the editor implements the draft vocabulary under the canonical offer token without inventing altsymbols equivalence.

The draft does not define how non-string Core enum values become JSON object keys in altenums, nor a representation for its stated enum-value descriptions. Authoring is limited to exact mappings over distinct string enums.
